title: LoopCache: Accelerating Long-Context Self-Speculative Decoding for Looped Transformers
abstract: arXiv:2611.24301v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Looped Transformers achieve large effective depth with compact models by repeatedly applying a weight-shared block across R recurrent steps, each maintaining a loop-specific key-value (KV) cache. To accelerate sequential loop execution, recent wave-style self-speculative methods like WaveFront Decoding (WFD) and LoopSpec pipeline draft and target tokens across loops in a single step. However, they face two critical limitations. First, they draft only at fixed loops and ignore intermediate prediction changes, wasting computation on stale trajectories. Second, batching tokens from different loops loads up to Rx the KV cache per step, severely amplifying memory traffic in long-context scenarios. To address these challenges, we propose LoopCache, an efficient self-speculative decoding framework for long-context Looped Transformers. translated_title: LoopCache：加速循环Transformer的长上下文自投机解码
translated_abstract: 循环Transformer通过在R个递归步骤中重复应用权重共享的模块，以紧凑的模型实现较大的有效深度，每个循环步骤维护一个特定于该循环的键值缓存。为了加速顺序循环执行，最近出现了波风格的自投机方法，如WaveFront Decoding（WFD）和LoopSpec，它们在单个步骤中将草词和目标词跨循环流水线化。然而，这些方法面临两个关键局限。首先，它们只在固定的循环处进行起草，忽略了中间预测的变化，在过时的轨迹上浪费计算资源。其次，将来自不同循环的词进行批处理时，每步会加载多达R倍的KV缓存，在长上下文场景中严重放大了内存流量。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了LoopCache，一个面向长上下文循环Transformer的高效自投机解码框架。基于预测切换与输出置信度之间的相关性，LoopCache引入了置信度引导的……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文提出LoopCache，一个面向长上下文循环Transformer的高效自投机解码框架，通过置信度引导机制解决现有波风格方法中固定循环起草浪费计算、以及跨循环批处理导致KV缓存内存流量放大R倍这两个关键问题。
en_tdlr: LoopCache is proposed as an efficient self-speculative decoding framework for long-context Looped Transformers, which uses confidence-guided mechanisms to address the key limitations of wave-style methods—wasted computation from fixed-loop drafting and up to Rx amplified KV cache memory traffic from cross-loop token batching.
